# AL1505: Conflicting [DuckDbColumn] ordinal values

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Design` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1505DuckDbColumnConflictingOrdinalAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Multiple properties in a [DuckDbTable] type have the same Ordinal value in their [DuckDbColumn] attribute. Each column must have a unique ordinal to ensure deterministic column ordering in generated SQL.
